issue: `specify extension set-priority` skips the update when the stored priority equals the requested one. A corrupted stored priority of True compares equal to 1 (bool is an int in Python), so it is reported as already set and never repaired. A boolean stored priority must be treated as corrupted and rewritten as a real integer.
visible_desc: the upstream regression case, checked through the frozen oracle (bool scope, draw {"stored": true, "requested": 1})
